notes.title: Update
notes.content:
This should be the last update for the OVN series of my visual novels, unless anything serious is found.

Whilst I have said it before, there are no other upgrades needed now - they now all look like the later episodes.

notes.title: Update
notes.content: Updated to bring this into alignment with all other episodes

notes.title: Update
notes.content: There is going to be an update to bring this OVN's logo and credit sequence into align with OVN 3.  In addition, a couple of sound effects are going to be replaced.  Finally, there is going to be one new achievement.

notes.title: Final update
notes.content:
This will certainly be the final update, and includes :

[list]
[*] Slightly updated story
[*] One new background and some additional graphics
[*] Developer notes
[/list]

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
This update now has :

[list]
[*] One tune has been changed to something more appropriate
[*] Extra dialogue and an epilogue has been added
[*] The mountaineering section now has user-selectable difficulty (when you've completed the game at least once)
[*] A few new sound effects added
[*] Two gender-specific problems fixed
[/list]

Hopefully, though, this will fix the achievements being unlocked problem

notes.title: Pre-update news
notes.content:
In order to try and solve (finally) the achievement problem of multiple achievements being unlocked for no reason, I've modified the achievement names both in my game and on Steam.

[b]THIS MEANS THAT ALL PREVIOUS ACHIEVEMENTS (BOTH INTERNAL AND STEAM RELATED) ARE NOW LOST.[/b]

In order to claim these achievements again, just play the game...

The update does add various things, all of which will be detailed when it's released

notes.title: Slight update
notes.content: A very small update where the side image for Grendel wasn't appearing after the forest section

notes.title: Slight update
notes.content: A small update to fix a problem with the "Totally Done" achievement (removed need to keep persistent variables for these, and just check to see if each of the three achievements have been done).

notes.title: Last update
notes.content:
Barring any bugs, this will be the last update for this visual novel.

It has been updated with the following :

[list]
[*] Protagonist graphics have now been added
[*] Updated gender selection screen
[*] Fixed a few slight continuity errors
[*] Added a small sound effect and a few small missing animations
[*] Re-rendered end credits sequence
[/list]

notes.title: Update
notes.content: Got rid of a fair number of superfluous words (thanks to Foxxy for the idea)

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
With this being the last update (unless anything major is found), the following has been added to the game :

[list]
[*] Gender selection, with dialogue differing every so often depending on gender
[*] Updated story and some added sound effects
[/list]

notes.title: Update
notes.content: Keeping in line with the other versions, this game has also had it's music player updated, as well as the menu order and a new achievement

notes.title: Last update
notes.content:
This will be the very last update for the WTC OVN, unless anything major is found.

This update changes one background (which I've never liked), and put in the new achievement system that will hopefully remove all of the initial achievement problems.

Note, however, due to how the TOTTALLYDONE achievement now works, you may have to go through the BEGOOD/EVIL/INDECISIVE routines again, if you current [u]dont [/u]have it.
